ops: repo-memory: Read/Write/Glob/Edit tools ONLY (Bash/Grep on /tmp blocked - use Glob with explicit path for enumeration). Bash works fine for gh/git in the repo working dir. After Write, `safeoutputs push_repo_memory` to validate. TOTAL memory must be <=12KB (10KB patch limit) - keep lean, stub/trim old entries every run rather than letting state.json grow unbounded.

create issue (WORKING RECIPE): Write tool -> eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md (repo working dir only, NOT /tmp/gh-aw/*). `jq -Rs '{title:"...", body:., labels:["eslint","eslint-factory"]}' eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md > eslint-factory/.tmp_issue.json`. `safeoutputs create_issue . < eslint-factory/.tmp_issue.json`. rm both temp files, confirm `git status --short eslint-factory/` clean.

dedupe: `gh api "repos/github/gh-aw/issues?state=open&per_page=100&labels=eslint-factory" --jq '.[] | {number,title}'` (query-string form works, -f form 403s). Newly-filed issues via safeoutputs do NOT appear in this query same-run. `gh api repos/github/gh-aw/issues/<n> --jq '{state,state_reason,closed_at,created_at}'` reflects already-applied history even for self-filed issues. For a fresh rule/theme, also sanity-check via `gh api "search/issues?q=repo:github/gh-aw+<rule-name>+<keyword>"` across ALL states (open+closed) since the theme may have been filed-and-expired under a different number.

NEW (2026-10-03): `gh api repos/github/gh-aw/pulls/<PR#>/files --jq '.[].filename'` gives the REAL changed-file list for a merge commit, unaffected by shallow-clone squash artifacts. Parse PR# from the HEAD commit message's trailing '(#NNNNN)'. This is now the PRIMARY discovery method when ruleCount is flat - try it before falling back to rotation re-grep.

Shallow clone: git log/blame on eslint-factory/src/rules attributes all files to one squash commit - unusable for rule age, and `git show --stat HEAD` on ANY commit shows the full all-insertions tree snapshot, not the real diff - conclusively confirmed dead for 14+ consecutive runs. Use the gh api pulls/<PR#>/files method instead (see above).

eslint-factory: NO node_modules/dist, npm firewalled - no live lint. Ground statically via Grep on non-test .cjs (config ignores *.test.cjs) + rule src/tests.
